# Drive report list

How various USB CD/DVD drives work with the CD Drive Player (CDDP-100), including drives that do not work.
This information is shared by users and us for reference.
A drive listed here as working is not covered by the guarantee unless it is one of the
[supported drives](../README.md#supported-drives).
A drive of the same model may also behave differently with another USB bridge (USB ID), enclosure or power supply.

**Your drive is not listed, or behaves differently? [Report it](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfNHyWI4UzrhYMMLvaGWSQck-JyMFxhJAjfBhDYurqOIGMEGg/viewform)** (a Google account is needed).

| OEM | USB Slim Portable Optical Drive | TEAC | DV-28S-V | 13FD:0840 | Slim USB | Extra 5 V | 🟠 Partially | Elehobica | [r0005](reports/r0005/README.md) |

Brand: the brand the drive is sold under (OEM: no brand). Name: the name or model printed on the drive.
Vendor, Product and USB ID are as shown on CONFIG > ABOUT of the player:
Vendor and Product come from the drive mechanism, USB ID from the USB bridge.
Power: "Player only" is the drive powered from CD DRIVE USB alone,
"Extra 5 V" is an extra 5 V supply to the drive (Y cable or auxiliary input).
